/work/orbit.title: Orbit - Remy
/work/orbit.description: Orbit Health is a digital care platform that makes everyday wellness feel clear, calm, and actionable.
p: Orbit Health is a digital care platform that makes everyday wellness feel clear, calm, and actionable.

Orbit Health had strong clinical content, but the product made everyday wellness feel difficult to navigate. Users struggled to understand what to do next and lost context between check-ins, plans, and progress.

The experience was reorganized around a simple daily rhythm: check in, understand the signal, and take one useful action. Clear progress cues and calmer content hierarchy made the platform feel more supportive without removing depth.

p: Luma is a modern commerce platform designed to make discovery, checkout, and repeat purchases feel effortless.

/work/northbeam.title: Northbeam - Remy
/work/northbeam.description: Northbeam is a smart-home platform that helps residents manage energy usage, security, and building services from a single app.
p: Northbeam is a smart-home platform that helps residents manage energy usage, security, and building services from a single app.

Northbeam's early prototype worked, but users found it confusing and inconsistent. Core actions, like adjusting the thermostat or checking a security camera, were buried three or four taps deep, and the visual design changed from screen to screen with no shared design language.

Remy started by mapping the full user journey to identify the moments that mattered most, checking in on the home, responding to alerts, and adjusting settings quickly. From there, the information architecture was rebuilt around three clear tabs instead of a sprawling menu, cutting the average task time by more than half.

p: Morrow is a personal finance experience that helps people understand their money and make confident decisions.
